answer: Re-attestations are stored in lantern and juniper lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the orchard graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 2055 identities would post 4667 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
